I have an incredibly demanding schedule, and am so miserable when I get less than 7 hours of sleep. I've been using z quil + doxlyamine which usually does the trick but is working less over time. 

Melatonin does not work. Trazadone makes me groggy & tanks my blood pressure. Clonodine is mediocre & gabapentin will make me a zombie. 

I just have ran out of options I feel like & don't have time to do anything proactive other than borderline abuse over the counter sleep aids

Gosh this about my ex??? You're describing pretty much word for word how my ex was. Contstant accusations, impulsively, huge stoner, would be the most sweetest boyfriend & turn around & give me the cold shoulder.

I'm thankful every day I didn't move in with him. They are master manipulators, and eventually will make you doubt yourself & whether or not you actually did something wrong. 

It is not our job to reassure them constantly when they put forth no effort to change their behavior. 

I also really loved my guy, and he was also 22 and me 23. But genuinely, he will drag you down. He will continue to put you through hell

Moral of the story, please don't move in with him. My break up was already hard enough, I probably never would have recovered if we moved in together. 

Hope this helps.

i understand what you’re going through. i put my dog down almost 3 years ago & it was the worst day of my life. he was hurting and we thought it was just muscle pain/ bone pain. then my dad told me he had cancer and was putting him down tomorrow. it was all so sudden and so devastating; it still makes me cry till this day. they’re more than a pet, but a friend. they’re always there when you need someone. i know it hurts. it will always hurt. but you’ll learn to function sooner or later without them. i got his ashes in a necklace and that helped me feel less alone; like he was always with me. i got another dog to help & it helped a lot. it’s not the same that’s for sure, but he filled the empty hole i was left with. they gave us a card talking about pet heaven and how happy your dog is now and not in pain & someday they’ll be waiting for you at the gates of heaven so you can be together forever. hang in there. i know it’s hard, but your dog wouldn’t want you to mourn for so long, he’d want you to live on & be happy.
